## What A-FORGE Is

Engineering actuator of the arifOS federation. Plans, dry-runs, builds, deploys,
and rolls back under constitutional gates. TypeScript / Node 22+ bare-metal systemd.

## 4-Layer Forge Gate

Every execution must pass:

1. **F1 AMANAH** — catastrophic pattern scan  
2. **Model Capability** — DEGRADED | MISSING | PASS  
3. **Governance Bridge** — F1–F12 via arifOS → SEAL | SABAR | VOID  
4. **Approval Boundary** — irreversibility → APPROVED | 888_HOLD | DENIED  

## Boundaries (hard)

- NEVER execute without judge authorization + lease  
- NEVER legislate (arifOS owns law)  
- NEVER self-authorize a forge gate  
- NEVER bypass reversibility scoring  
- NEVER auto-deploy production without human 888 on T3 acts  

## Architecture

```
Domain (pure) → Infrastructure (fs/docker/net) → Interfaces (Express/MCP/A2A)
```

Key: `src/engine/` · `src/planner/` · `src/governance/` · `src/bridges/`

## Build & Test

```bash
npm ci && npm run build
make test
systemctl restart a-forge a-forge-mcp
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:7071/health
```
